P01: He Livestreamed His Mom Sleeping. Her Head Hid in the Rice Cooker.

Three million people watch "Dinner with Mom". None of them know what Mom does at 2 a.m. — with just her head.
Told by the ghost herself: a ma lai, a Vietnamese ghost whose head flies off at night, and her son who turned her into content.
P02: The Underworld Took Attendance at 3 A.M. — and Marked the Boss Present

A factory boss rewrites a worker's time of death to dodge a curse and cash in. He even signs the form "like family".
The underworld reads paperwork very carefully. Told by the than trung, the underworld's most punctual clerk.
P03: Three Generations Guarded This Jar. Nobody Was Allowed to Open It.

An old-quarter house is about to be sold to a hotel chain. In the storeroom, a polite little ghost keeps counting.
Told by the ma xo, the corner ghost who guards a family's wealth — whatever that wealth turns out to be.
P04: For Three Days, Nobody Looked Up From Their Screens

A ghost who hides people for a living meets a family that never looks up. Eight hundred years undefeated, until apartment 27-08.
Told by the ma giau, the Vietnamese hider ghost. Nobody gets hurt. Bin is fine. He had bubble tea.

P01-SH1: 3 Million People Watched Mom Eat Dinner 🍚
Dinner on a livestream, and the secret Mom keeps at night.
P01-SH2: Mom's Only Rule: Never Cover My Neck
Grandma gave one rule. The son forgot it.
P01-SH3: An 8-hour healing stream… so what just flew past the window?
P01-SH4: 4 Seconds on Camera: A Blanket, Flat at the Neck
Nine thousand people stayed awake for him.
P01-SH5: He Tucked Mom In for the First Time… Worst Mistake
And her head couldn't get back.
P01-SH7: Mom's New Contract: 50% of the Revenue
Three months online and the ghost has a revenue deal. Her head, her cut.
P02-SH1: The Time Clock Only Has an IN Button ⏱️
The factory is family. And family never clocks out.
P02-SH2: The Most Expensive Words He Ever Signed: "Like Family"
He moved a time of death from 2:10 to 5 a.m. On paper.
P02-SH3: Die at This Hour and the Underworld Comes Back for Family
The boss fixed the paperwork. The underworld read it.
P02-SH4: 3 A.M.: The Time Clock Printed the Boss's Name
Three knocks. One file. One name to call.
P02-SH5: A mistake. But a mistake by the book.
P02-SH6: The Boss Wore Mourning Clothes to a Business Meeting
The underworld didn't take his life. It took his calendar.
P02-SH7: The Underworld Docked the Boss's Attendance Bonus
Three nights late to his own mourning. No bonus this month.
P03-SH1: What it eats, what it guards — and tonight it counts to 413.
P03-SH2: How to Survive a House Ghost
Three rules. Rule three: sell the house, and the house's things leave.
P03-SH3: Bribing a Ghost With Rice Cakes
One plate of offerings for the jar? This ghost doesn't take bribes.
P03-SH4: He Wanted to Sell Tickets to the Family Altar
The owner wants to monetize the altar. The ghost has a job to do.
P03-SH5: This House Is 30 Feet Deep. The Tape Never Hits the Wall.
The surveyor measured all night and left a one-star review.
P03-SH6: Nobody has opened it for three generations. Tonight something is counting.
P03-SH7: Opening a 3-Generation Jar in Front of Half the Street
The jar opens. The creditors arrive. The buyer walks.
P04-SH1: Hides kids, blinds families, returns them when you bang the tray. Nowadays you wait for the phone to die.
P04-SH2: How to Survive Being Hidden by a Ghost
Learn from Bin, age ten: ask for the wifi, order bubble tea, borrow a charger.
P04-SH3: The Secret to a Perfect Kid
All homework done. Never asks for the phone. Secret in the comments.
P04-SH4: People used to bang it to call someone home. Now they bang it to close a sale.
P04-SH5: Dad's Been on Mute for 3 Days
Three days of meetings. Shirt and tie on top, shorts below. One sentence.
P04-SH6: Dinner, day three. Mom says Bin is so good today. So where is the real Bin?
P04-SH7: Three hours until sunrise. The ghost pulls the breaker and bangs on the fire door.
